name: Lenomila Shelf
releaseNotes: Fixes store self-update detection for installed v0.3.10 clients by accepting both raw RSA detached catalog signatures and Base64 text signatures. The public catalog signature is Base64-compatible again so older clients can verify the catalog, see this update, and move onto the dual-format verifier.
description: Private Android app shelf for signed GitHub-hosted APK releases and managed app updates.
